title: Ledgerly finance operations landing page
audience: Finance leaders at growing companies with 50–500 employees
scenario: Ledgerly is launching an automated close-management product that connects reconciliations, approvals, and audit trails.
task: Build a responsive single-page marketing site that establishes trust and drives qualified visitors to request a demo.

content.primary_heading: Close the books without closing your eyes
sections: Navigation with Product, Security, Customers, Resources, Sign in, and Request a demo
Hero with the primary heading, a concise automation promise, Request a demo, and See how it works
Proof strip naming Northstar, Helix, Orchard, and Arcwell
Workflow section covering Reconcile, Review, Approve, and Report
Security section with SOC 2, role-based access, and immutable audit trail
Customer quote from Maya Chen, VP Finance at Northstar
Final demo call to action and complete footer

requirements: Use semantic header, main, section, and footer landmarks
Make Request a demo the unambiguous primary action
Represent the four-step workflow as ordered content rather than decorative labels
Include meaningful accessible text for any product illustration
Provide a narrow-screen navigation treatment and responsive section layouts
constraints: Do not use remote images, fonts, scripts, or APIs
Do not claim certifications beyond the supplied SOC 2 statement
Do not use lorem ipsum, placeholder copy, or invented customer metrics
The page must remain useful if decorative imagery is absent
evaluation_focus: Trust-building information order for a risk-sensitive buyer
Clear differentiation between primary and secondary calls to action
Accessible representation of product workflow and security claims
